annotations.title: Read a sitemap or sitemap index

description: Read a sitemap or sitemap index. Use when a task needs the list of URLs a site publishes, from an XML, gzipped XML or plain-text sitemap or a sitemap index, with lastmod where the site gives it and hard caps so a huge file cannot flood the agent. Cost: 1 credit per call.

expand_index.description: Also read up to 5 child sitemaps of an index on the same site, at most 2 MiB each. Off by default.

limit.description: Most entries to return, 1 to 5000. Defaults to 200.

url.description: The sitemap URL, or a site root to find it through robots.txt and then /sitemap.xml.

name: sitemap_read
